title: Audit Trail Explorer
tagline: Every change to your data, searchable in one timeline.
description: A searchable timeline of every automated decision, built for the judging pipeline.

title: Standup Digest
tagline: Your team's standup, summarised before the coffee is poured.
description: Collects yesterday's commits and open reviews into a two-minute morning summary.

title: Flake Finder
tagline: Finds the flaky tests before they find you.
description: Watches CI history and flags the tests that fail intermittently before they waste a morning.

title: Draft in progress
description: Still being written - stays out of the gallery and out of judging until submitted.

title: Pager Triage
tagline: One incident instead of forty alerts.
description: Groups related alerts into one incident so the on-call engineer sees the cause, not forty symptoms.

title: Meeting Lantern
tagline: Decisions and owners out of every meeting recording.
description: Turns a meeting recording into decisions and owners, posted to the right channel.

title: Green Main
tagline: A merge queue that bisects its own failures.
